newsitem.title: INDIA: Indian call rates steady, seen up on Wednesday.
newsitem.headline: Indian call rates steady, seen up on Wednesday.

text.p: Indian call money rates opened steady at 3.50-4.50 percent on Tuesday and was expected to remain range-bound, dealers said.

"The repo auctions, the state development loan and the uptrend in credit offtake may push the call rates to above 5.0 percent levels on Wednesday," said R. Narayan, Assistant Manager Treasury at Bank of Nova Scotia.

But prices of securities were not moving in tandem with the call rates because of selling pressure, Vinod Dixit, treasury manager at Centurion Bank, said. He said dealers were booking profits by offloading securities.
